questions.stem: A bile duct is completely blocked while pancreatic secretion remains normal. Absorption of which nutrient class should decline most sharply?
options: Lipids
Amino acids
Monosaccharides
Mineral ions
questions.explanation: Bile salts emulsify fats and help form micelles, increasing access for lipase and carrying lipid digestion products to the intestinal surface.

questions.stem: Why does pepsin lose most of its activity after acidic chyme enters the small intestine?
options: Pepsin is converted into bile
Bicarbonate raises the pH away from pepsin's optimum
All proteins have already been absorbed in the stomach
The small intestine contains no water
questions.explanation: Pancreatic bicarbonate neutralizes gastric acid. Pepsin is adapted to strongly acidic conditions, so the higher intestinal pH reduces its activity.

questions.stem: Damage limited to the lacteals inside intestinal villi would most directly reduce the transport of:
options: Glucose into blood capillaries
Amino acids into the hepatic portal vein
Chylomicrons into the lymphatic system
Water by osmosis
questions.explanation: Absorbed long-chain lipids are repackaged as chylomicrons and enter lacteals, whereas most sugars and amino acids enter blood capillaries.

questions.stem: The sodium–potassium pumps of intestinal epithelial cells stop. Which absorptive process should weaken as the sodium gradient collapses?
options: Simple diffusion of lipid-soluble molecules
Emulsification by bile salts
Hydrolysis of proteins in the stomach
Sodium–glucose co-transport from the lumen
questions.explanation: The basolateral sodium–potassium pump maintains the sodium gradient that powers secondary active co-transport of sodium and glucose across the apical membrane.

questions.stem: Food is broken into smaller pieces by chewing. Which outcome follows most directly?
options: The rate of subsequent enzyme digestion can increase
Some starch is hydrolysed to maltose

questions.explanation: The rate of subsequent enzyme digestion can increase. Mechanical breakdown exposes a greater surface area to digestive secretions.
